rows.label: P1
rows.predicate: The acceleration floor tracks the drive rate, $a_0(z)\propto H(z)$: a relation, $\Om$-blind, derived from L1 under the gravity realisation (D5); the knee shifts and the Tully--Fisher zero-point evolves as $E(z)^{1/4}$. Falsifier: a floor constant in redshift, or tracking other than $H(z)$. Confrontation (43-muse): MUSE-DARK III excludes a constant floor to $z=1.3$; RC100 implies the local floor by $z\simeq2$, pending refit.

rows.label: P2
rows.predicate: Equal force, unequal entanglement (D5): sources gravitate by full masses; synchronised cross-source pairs carry the conditional phase $f_1f_2\varphi_N$, spread pairs imprint which-branch data, the incoherent channel separable at generic geometry ($C=0$ at $f=0$); $f=m_c/m$ microscopic. The discriminator is the calibrated conditional phase rate at fixed centre-of-mass superposition. Falsifier: a calibrated conditional phase rate off $f_1f_2\varphi_N$. Confrontation: none, filed before data.

rows.label: P3
rows.predicate: \textbf{Flavour} (targets): the Georgi--Jarlskog double ratio $9$; the locks of G17 read in the $\overline{\mathrm{MS}}$ scheme; the $m_1{=}0$ floor, $\sum m_\nu=58.8$ meV at NuFIT 6.0, on the boundary-branch realisation (28:B6). Falsifier: inverted ordering, a degenerate spectrum, or $\sum m_\nu$ off $58.8$ meV beyond the fit's tolerance. Confrontation: the data give $10.4\pm0.5$, an open $15\%$ tension (28:X5).

rows.label: P4
rows.predicate: No fourth generation, no fifth force, an empty desert, no TeV supersymmetry, no new dark-matter particle, no beyond-SM $(g{-}2)_\mu$, and the proton effectively stable ($\tau_p\gtrsim10^{45}$ yr; G9). Entailed by the closed ladder of the rank-five frame ($\dim\Lambda^{\mathrm{even}}=16$, D6), given the role-to-matter realisation (27:B6, 27:C10) and completeness (A3). Falsifier: any excluded object observed. Confrontation: none observed.
